title: MIS Analyst_Rz
description:
Job Title: Corporate Quality MIS Analyst – Automotive / Wiring Harness
  
  
Location: Goregaon East
  
  
Experience: 3–7 Years
  
  
Industry: Manufacturing
  
  
Role Type: Corporate HO-Based
  
  
**Job Summary**
We are looking for a Corporate Quality MIS Analyst with 3–7 years of experience in the Automotive, Wiring Harness, or Auto Components industry. The candidate will be responsible for consolidating quality data from multiple plants, analysing Quality KPIs, preparing MIS reports and dashboards, and providing management-level insights for quality improvement.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Consolidate plant-wise Quality MIS, KPIs, and performance reports.
* Analyse PPM, rejection, rework, FPY, customer complaints, CAPA, and 8D data.
* Prepare quality MIS reports, dashboards, trend analysis, and management presentations.
* Coordinate with Plant Quality Teams to ensure timely and accurate data submission.
* Identify quality trends, deviations, recurring issues, and improvement opportunities.
* Maintain standardized Corporate Quality MIS formats, databases, and reporting systems.
* Support management reviews with accurate quality data and analytical insights.
* Track plant-wise quality performance and highlight gaps against defined targets.

Key Requirements
  
  

* 3–7 years of experience in Quality MIS / Quality Reporting within Automotive, Wiring Harness, or Auto Components.
* Strong understanding of Quality KPIs, MIS reporting, and data analysis.
* Advanced proficiency in MS Excel, including Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, and dashboards.
* Good knowledge of PowerPoint and management presentation preparation.
* Knowledge of 7 QC Tools, 8D, CAPA, Root Cause Analysis, PPM, Rejection, Rework, and FPY.
* Strong analytical, coordination, communication, and reporting skills.
* Experience coordinating with multiple plant/quality teams will be preferred.

Skills: powerpoint,vlookup,mis reporting,mis,advanced excel,mis analyst,quality mis analyst,pivot tables,mis executive,reporting,hlookups,excel

title: Senior Business Systems Lead
description:
**About Our Company**
Ameriprise India LLP has been providing client based financial solutions to help clients plan and achieve their financial objectives for 20 years. We are part of Ameriprise Financial Inc., a US financial planning company headquartered in Minneapolis with a global presence and diversified financial services leader with more than $1.5 trillion in assets under management, administration and advisement as of year-end 2024. The firm’s focus areas include Asset Management and Advice, Retirement Planning and Insurance Protection.
  
  
Be part of an inclusive, collaborative culture that rewards you for your contributions, and work with other talented individuals who share your passion for doing great work. You’ll also have plenty of opportunities to make your mark at the office and a difference in your community. So, if you're talented, driven and want to work for a strong, ethical company that cares, take the next step and create a career at Ameriprise India LLP.
  
  
**Job Description**
We are seeking a high-performing Sr. Business Systems Analyst (BSA) with a strong focus on AI and automation initiatives. This role is ideal for a professional who thrives in ambiguity, enjoys solving complex business problems, and can turn data and insights into action. The BSA will lead discovery, shape solutions, support execution, and clearly communicate value and outcomes to senior leaders.
  
  
This role partners closely with business, technology, analytics, and operations teams to deliver scalable, high-impact AI and automation solutions that improve efficiency, reduce risk, and enhance client and associate experiences.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
AI & Automation Discovery
  
  
Lead structured discovery efforts to identify AI and automation opportunities across business processes.
  
  
Partner with business stakeholders to understand pain points, inefficiencies, risk areas, and growth opportunities.
  
  
Translate business problems into clear problem statements, hypotheses, and solution concepts.
  
  
Evaluate feasibility across data availability, technology readiness, risk, and scalability.
  
  
Solution Design & Requirements
  
  
Support end‑to‑end execution from concept through delivery, including testing support, defect triage, and go‑live readiness.
  
  
Ensure solutions align to business intent, operational realities, and control requirements.
  
  
Partner with business and technology leads to manage dependencies, timelines, and risks.
  
  
Support implementation planning, change readiness, and post‑implementation validation.
  
  
Execution & Implementation Support
  
  
Support execution from concept through delivery, including testing, defect resolution, and go-live readiness.
  
  
Validate solutions against original business intent and operational requirements.
  
  
Partner with project managers and technical leads to manage dependencies, risks, and timelines.
  
  
Support implementation planning, change readiness, and post-implementation outcome validation.
  
  
Data Analytics & Storytelling
  
  
Analyze data to size opportunities, quantify benefits, and support prioritization decisions.
  
  
Develop insights using structured analysis, dashboards, and exploratory data techniques.
  
  
Translate complex data and technical concepts into clear, executive-level narratives.
  
  
Build compelling stories that connect insights to business outcomes and strategic priorities.
  
  
Senior Leader Engagement
  
  
Work directly with senior and executive leaders to shape ideas, test assumptions, and drive decisions.
  
  
Present recommendations, trade-offs, and outcomes with clarity and confidence.
  
  
Influence without authority and navigate ambiguity using structured thinking and strong communication.
  
  
Serve as a trusted advisor on AI, automation, and process optimization initiatives.
  
  
**Required Qualifications**
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Technology, Analytics, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  
  
8+ years of experience as a Business Systems Analyst, Business Analyst, or similar role.
  
  
Demonstrated experience leading discovery and solutioning for complex, cross-functional initiatives.
  
  
Strong analytical skills with the ability to evaluate opportunities using data and insights.
  
  
Experience working directly with senior leaders and executive stakeholders.
  
  
Excellent written, verbal, and presentation communication skills.
  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**
Experience delivering AI, intelligent automation, or workflow automation solutions.
  
  
**Experience Translating Business Needs Into Technical Designs And Requirements.**
Hands-on experience with analytics, dashboards, or data visualization tools.
  
  
Financial services, operations, or regulated industry experience.
  
  
In-Office Collaboration
  
  
We are a client-centric, relationship-based business. Working together, in-person, is foundational to how we achieve results. By fostering a culture of face-to-face collaboration, idea sharing, productivity and personal connection, we deliver for our stakeholders — clients, advisors, employees and shareholders. Our employees work in the office at least three (3) days per week, with flexibility to work from home two (2) days per week. Some roles may require additional in-office time or different in-office expectations, and specific requirements will be discussed during the hiring process.
